scope: Data-plan schema and source control-flow review; no browser, native package, SDK session, CI, model mutation, clock mutation or storage fixture writes executed in this audit.

raceReadiness.gateName: Skip authored intro with jump and wait for real countdown
raceReadiness.finding: Step 4 stage=playing admits intro/countdown, but is not the throttle readiness gate: step 5 sends the original jump action to skip the intro and requires original mode=racing before step 6 sends UP.

storage.finding: Original Menus.js character onConfirm assigns characterId and invokes save(); course onConfirm assigns courseId/difficulty and invokes save() before game.startRace. save() writes ponpoko.prefs. Normal plan A/START confirmation reaches these callbacks without storage injection. Native persistence verifier requires a nonempty actual save and matches the native values; no new restart verification was run here.

menuInput.finding: The cached-frame pressed edges call original UI.nav. Title/character/course ok actions call the same confirm callbacks as visible buttons. Character/course selection confirmation delays are original 480/420 ms; the plan waits for the actual next screen/mode, with 700 ms confirmation holds. No focus on hidden buttons or pointer clicks is required.
menuInput.historicalEvidenceScope: Existing synthetic bridge run exercised normal menus and actual racing; it is not an original SDK/native persistence result.

limitations: This is static source/plan validation, not a rerun of gameplay or native packages.
Real native countdown may exceed the existing 60 second plan limit on slow hardware; such a timeout must be retained as a failure and must not be bypassed by changing model time.
The character-selection RIGHT step asserts the current menu, not the selected character identity; this audit does not claim a native selection-specific assertion.
